title: Play AC Online messages file
description: Lines a script or another mod can use, by key. A script reads its own with message("key"), another mod's with message("author.mod:key"). This file cannot carry a $schema key (every key is a line): point your editor at messages.schema.json in its settings instead. From api 2, content.messages may name a folder of <lang>.json files instead (en.json required; de, es, fr, it), each by these rules, a translation holding only keys en.json has. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

additionalProperties.description: 1 to 400 UTF-8 bytes. Lines wrap at 24 characters, 4 lines a page.
